info.name: BookingEngineApi Account notes Credit cards API

items.docs:
Returns all credit cards, possibly filtered by identifiers, [Customers](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/customers/#customer) or other filters.
Note this operation uses [Pagination](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/pagination/) and supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property).

Adds a new tokenized credit card to the specified customer. To be able to use this operation special permission has to be granted during certification. Note this operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).
Creates payment for specified customer credit card and charges the credit card via a gateway. Note that the kind of the card has to be `Gateway`.

Disable an existing credit card in the system. Only gateway credit cards can be disabled. Note this operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).
